Thanks Rachel — quick update from infra side.

Short summary (for the slide):
- Observation: Latency regressions occur on ~1.7% of requests when KV cache misses coincide with large prompt prefixes (median 1200 tokens).
- Hypothesis: Memory fragmentation when switching kernels + aggressive batching under <8 pending requests causes higher tail latency.
- Mitigation in-flight: rolling patch to kernel allocator and a throttled batching policy; current canary shows tail latency down ~35%.

I uploaded the troubleshooting notes and a small runbook (latency_regression_runbook.md) to Drive. If the patch doesn’t fully close it, we should include a customer-facing mitigation (short-term: reduced max batch size for their Dedicated nodes).

Attachment: latency_regression_runbook.md (logs + steps)

On Thu we’ll know whether the kernel patch is green; I’ll prepare the single-slide note and paste it into the deck.

— Jonas
